title: Unbroken Ages content file
description: A content file holds any number of categories, each an array of entries. Entries are add (default), replace, patch or delete operations ($op). In patches, arrays accept {"$append": [...]}, {"$prepend": [...]}, {"$removeWhere": {...}}, {"$remove": [...]}. The C# loader (ModLoader) is authoritative; this schema powers editor autocomplete.

target.description: UnitStrength: the unit class or tag it applies to (empty = every military unit).

naturalWonder.description: Placed once per map by the generator; never removed.

empireModifiers.description: World wonders: modifiers on every city of the owner.

model.description: Client model under assets/models, drawn in every era (world wonders).
